quote: We propose generating multiple paraphrases and using their averaged embedding to train the surrogate model so as to bypass the detection of embedding watermark;

We generate P unique paraphrases for each input text and then filter out bad paraphrases ... We experiment with three paraphrase methods: (i) prompting GPT-3.5-turbo ... (ii) using an specialised paraphrasing model, DIPPER ... (iii) round‑trip translation using NLLB ...

We use the average cosine similarity between the recovered embeddings and original embeddings and then take their difference (Δcos). Based on the cosine similarity scores, we also compute the area under the ROC curve (AUC). Downstream utility is measured with accuracy (ACC) and F1‑score (F1).
